Alert.description: Always on the lookout for danger

Athlete.description: You have undergone extensive physical training

passive_abilities.advantage_deception: when trying to pass yourself off as another person
passive_abilities.advantage_performance: when trying to entertain an audience

Charger.description: You excel at charging into battle

passive_abilities.charge_attack: when you use your action to Dash, you can make a melee weapon attack or shove

Crossbow Expert.description: Thanks to extensive practice with the crossbow

passive_abilities.ignore_cover: when making ranged attacks within 5 feet

Defensive Duelist.description: When you are wielding a finesse weapon with which you are proficient

passive_abilities.reaction_ac_bonus: add proficiency bonus to AC against one melee attack

Dual Wielder.description: You master fighting with two weapons

passive_abilities.dual_wield_non_light: can use two-weapon fighting with non-light weapons

Dungeon Delver.description: Alert to the hidden traps and secret doors found in many dungeons

prerequisites: Ability to cast at least one spell
Elemental Adept.description: When you gain this feat, choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder

passive_abilities.treat_1_as_2: treat 1s as 2s for chosen damage type

Grappler.description: You've developed the skills necessary to hold your own in close-quarters grappling

passive_abilities.grapple_advantage: advantage on attack rolls against grappled creatures
passive_abilities.grapple_restrain: can use action to restrain grappled creature

Great Weapon Master.description: You've learned to put the weight of a weapon to your advantage

passive_abilities.power_attack: take -5 penalty to attack roll for +10 damage
passive_abilities.bonus_action_attack: bonus action attack on critical hit or kill with heavy weapon

passive_abilities.healer_kit_healing: healer's kit can restore 1d6+4+target's level hit points

Heavily Armored.description: You have trained to master the use of heavy armor

Heavy Armor Master.description: You can use your armor to deflect strikes that would kill others

passive_abilities.damage_reduction: reduce non-magical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage by 3

Inspiring Leader.description: You can spend 10 minutes inspiring your companions

passive_abilities.inspiring_leader: up to 6 friendly creatures gain temporary hit points equal to your level + your Charisma modifier

Keen Mind.description: You have a mind that can track time, direction, and detail with uncanny precision

passive_abilities.perfect_recall: always know which way is north, number of hours left before next sunset, and can accurately recall anything seen or heard within past month

Lightly Armored.description: You have trained to master the use of light armor

Linguist.description: You have studied languages and codes

Lucky.description: You have inexplicable luck that seems to kick in at just the right moment

passive_abilities.luck_advantage: can spend luck point to roll additional d20

Mage Slayer.description: You have practiced techniques useful in melee combat against spellcasters

passive_abilities.opportunity_attack_caster: opportunity attack when creature casts spell within 5 feet
passive_abilities.disadvantage_concentration: attacks cause disadvantage on concentration saves
passive_abilities.advantage_saves: advantage on saving throws against spells cast within 5 feet

Magic Initiate.description: Choose a class: bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard

Martial Adept.description: You have martial training that allows you to perform special combat maneuvers

passive_abilities.maneuvers: learn 2 maneuvers from Battle Master archetype

Medium Armor Master.description: You have practiced moving in medium armor to gain the following benefits

passive_abilities.medium_armor_dex_bonus: no penalty for wearing medium armor
passive_abilities.medium_armor_stealth: can add up to 3 Dexterity modifier to AC when wearing medium armor

Mobile.description: You are exceptionally speedy and agile

passive_abilities.dash_difficult_terrain: dash doesn't cost extra movement in difficult terrain
passive_abilities.no_opportunity_attack: no opportunity attacks from creatures you attack

Moderately Armored.description: You have trained to master the use of medium armor and shields

passive_abilities.medium_armor_proficiency: proficiency with medium armor and shields

Mounted Combatant.description: You are a dangerous foe to face while mounted

passive_abilities.mount_advantage: advantage on melee attack rolls against unmounted creatures smaller than mount
passive_abilities.mount_protection: force attacks targeting mount to target you instead
passive_abilities.mount_save_advantage: mount has advantage on Dexterity saving throws

Observant.description: Quick to notice details of your environment

passive_abilities.lip_reading: can read lips of creatures you can see

Polearm Master.description: You can keep your enemies at bay with reach weapons

passive_abilities.bonus_action_attack: bonus action attack with opposite end of polearm
passive_abilities.opportunity_attack_enter: opportunity attack when creature enters your reach

passive_abilities.saving_throw_proficiency: proficiency in chosen ability's saving throws

Ritual Caster.description: You have learned a number of spells that you can cast as rituals

passive_abilities.ritual_spellbook: gain a ritual spellbook with 2 1st-level ritual spells
passive_abilities.ritual_casting: can cast rituals from chosen class

Savage Attacker.description: Once per turn when you roll damage for a melee weapon attack

passive_abilities.reroll_damage: once per turn, reroll weapon damage dice and use either result

Sentinel.description: You have mastered techniques to take advantage of every drop in any enemy's guard

passive_abilities.opportunity_attack_ally: opportunity attack when creature attacks ally within 5 feet
passive_abilities.disadvantage_disengage: creatures can't gain advantage on opportunity attacks against you

Sharpshooter.description: You have mastered ranged weapons and can make shots that others find impossible

passive_abilities.power_shot: take -5 penalty to attack roll for +10 damage with ranged weapon

Shield Master.description: You use shields not just for protection but also for offense

passive_abilities.shield_bonus_action: bonus action to shove with shield
passive_abilities.shield_dex_saves: add shield's AC bonus to Dexterity saving throws
passive_abilities.shield_damage_immunity: no damage from Dexterity saving throw if you make the save

Skilled.description: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools

Skulker.description: You are expert at slinking through shadows

passive_abilities.miss_advantage: when you miss with ranged attack, you can hide as bonus action

prerequisites: Ability to cast at least one spell
Spell Sniper.description: You have learned techniques to enhance your attacks with certain kinds of spells

passive_abilities.spell_range_double: double the range of spells with attack rolls
passive_abilities.spell_ignore_cover: ignore half and three-quarters cover for spells
passive_abilities.spell_cantrip: learn one cantrip that requires an attack roll

Tavern Brawler.description: Accustomed to rough-and-tumble fighting using whatever weapons happen to be at hand

passive_abilities.unarmed_strike: unarmed strike uses d4 and is considered a weapon
passive_abilities.grapple_bonus_action: bonus action to grapple after unarmed strike

Tough.description: Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your level

prerequisites: Ability to cast at least one spell
War Caster.description: You have practiced casting spells in the midst of combat

passive_abilities.advantage_concentration: advantage on Constitution saving throws for concentration
passive_abilities.spell_opportunity_attack: can cast spell as opportunity attack
passive_abilities.spell_components: can perform somatic components while holding weapons/shields

Weapon Master.description: You have practiced extensively with a variety of weapons

Fey Touched.description: Your exposure to the Feywild's magic has changed you

passive_abilities.spell_casting: can cast each spell once per long rest

Shadow Touched.description: Your exposure to the Shadowfell's magic has changed you

passive_abilities.spell_casting: can cast each spell once per long rest

Crusher.description: You are practiced in the art of crushing your enemies

passive_abilities.critical_hit_push: when you score a critical hit with a bludgeoning weapon, push target 5 feet
passive_abilities.bludgeoning_advantage: once per turn, when you hit with bludgeoning damage, next attack against target has advantage

Piercer.description: You are practiced in the art of piercing your enemies

passive_abilities.critical_hit_reroll: when you score a critical hit with a piercing weapon, roll one additional damage die
passive_abilities.piercing_reroll: once per turn, when you hit with piercing damage, reroll one damage die

Slasher.description: You are practiced in the art of slashing your enemies

passive_abilities.critical_hit_slow: when you score a critical hit with a slashing weapon, target's speed is reduced by 10 feet
passive_abilities.slashing_disadvantage: once per turn, when you hit with slashing damage, target has disadvantage on next attack

Telekinetic.description: You learn to move things with your mind

passive_abilities.extended_range: mage hand range increased by 30 feet
passive_abilities.telekinetic_shove: bonus action to shove creature within 30 feet

Telepathic.description: You awaken the ability to connect your mind to the minds of others

passive_abilities.telepathic_speech: can communicate telepathically with any creature within 60 feet
passive_abilities.spell_casting: can cast detect thoughts once per long rest

Gunner.description: You have a quick hand and keen eye when employing firearms

passive_abilities.close_quarters: no disadvantage on ranged attacks within 5 feet

Skill Expert.description: You have honed your proficiency with particular skills

Chef.description: You have mastered the art of cooking

passive_abilities.special_dish: can create special dishes that provide temporary hit points
passive_abilities.healing_feast: can create a feast that provides healing

Acid Splash.description: You hurl a bubble of acid. Choose one creature within range, or choose two creatures within range that are within 5 feet of each other.

Create Bonfire.description: A bonfire appears at a point you choose within range.

Dancing Lights.description: You create up to four torch-sized lights within range.

Druidcraft.description: Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range.

Fire Bolt.description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range.

Friends.description: For the duration, you have advantage on all Charisma checks directed at one creature of your choice that isn't hostile toward you.

Frostbite.description: You cause numbing frost to form on one creature that you can see within range.

Green-Flame Blade.description: You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you.

Guidance.description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice.

Light.description: You touch one object that is no larger than 10 feet in any dimension.

Mage Hand.description: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range.

Magic Stone.description: You touch one to three pebbles and imbue them with magic.

Mending.description: This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch.

Message.description: You point your finger toward a creature within range and whisper a message.

Minor Illusion.description: You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration.

Mold Earth.description: You choose a portion of dirt or stone that you can see within range and that fits within a 5-foot cube.

Poison Spray.description: You extend your hand toward a creature you can see within range and project a puff of noxious gas from your palm.

Prestidigitation.description: This spell is a minor magical trick that novice spellcasters use for practice.

Produce Flame.description: A flickering flame appears in your hand.

Ray of Frost.description: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range.

Sacred Flame.description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range.

Shape Water.description: You choose an area of water that you can see within range and that fits within a 5-foot cube.

Shillelagh.description: The wood of a club or quarterstaff you are holding is imbued with nature's power.

Shocking Grasp.description: Lightning springs from your hand to deliver a shock to a creature you try to touch.

Spare the Dying.description: You touch a living creature that has 0 hit points.

Sword Burst.description: You create a momentary circle of spectral blades that sweep around you.

Thaumaturgy.description: You manifest a minor wonder, a sign of supernatural power, within range.

Thorn Whip.description: You create a long, vine-like whip covered in thorns that lashes out at your command toward a creature in range.

Thunderclap.description: You create a burst of thunderous sound, which can be heard 100 feet away.

Toll the Dead.description: You point at one creature you can see within range, and the sound of a dolorous bell fills the air around it for a moment.

True Strike.description: You extend your hand and point a finger at a target in range.

Vicious Mockery.description: You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at a creature you can see within range.

Absorb Elements.description: The spell captures some of the incoming energy, lessening its effect on you and storing it for your next melee attack.

Alarm.description: You set an alarm against unwanted intrusion.

Animal Friendship.description: This spell lets you convince a beast that you mean it no harm.

Armor of Agathys.description: A protective magical force surrounds you, manifesting as a spectral frost that covers you and your gear.

Bane.description: Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range must make Charisma saving throws.

Beast Bond.description: You establish a telepathic link with one beast you touch that is friendly to you or charmed by you.

Bless.description: You bless up to three creatures of your choice within range.

Burning Hands.description: As you hold your hands with thumbs touching and fingers spread, a thin sheet of flames shoots forth from your outstretched fingertips.

Charm Person.description: You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range.

Command.description: You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range.

Compelled Duel.description: You attempt to compel a creature into a duel.

Comprehend Languages.description: For the duration, you understand the literal meaning of any spoken language that you hear.

Create or Destroy Water.description: You either create or destroy water.

Cure Wounds.description: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

Detect Evil and Good.description: For the duration, you know if there is an aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, fiend, or undead within 30 feet of you.

Detect Magic.description: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you.

Detect Poison and Disease.description: For the duration, you can sense the presence and location of poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases within 30 feet of you.

Disguise Self.description: You make yourself—including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person—appear different until the spell ends or until you use your action to dismiss it.

Divine Favor.description: Your prayer empowers you with divine radiance.

Ensnaring Strike.description: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, a writhing mass of thorny vines appears at the point of impact.

Entangle.description: Grasping weeds and vines sprout from the ground in a 20-foot radius centered on a point within range.

Expeditious Retreat.description: This spell allows you to move at an incredible pace.

Faerie Fire.description: Each object in a 20-foot cube within range is outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice).

False Life.description: Bolstering yourself with a necromantic facsimile of life, you gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points for the duration.

Feather Fall.description: Choose up to five falling creatures within range.

Find Familiar.description: You gain the service of a familiar, a spirit that takes an animal form you choose.

Fog Cloud.description: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range.

Goodberry.description: Up to ten berries appear in your hand and are infused with magic for the duration.

Grease.description: Slick grease covers the ground in a 10-foot square centered on a point within range and turns it into difficult terrain for the duration.

Guiding Bolt.description: A flash of light streaks toward a creature of your choice within range.

Hail of Thorns.description: The next time you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack before the spell ends, this spell creates a rain of thorns that sprouts from your ranged weapon or ammunition.

Healing Word.description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

Hellish Rebuke.description: You point your finger, and the creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by hellish flames.

Heroism.description: A willing creature you touch is imbued with bravery.

Hex.description: You place a curse on a creature that you can see within range.

Hunter's Mark.description: You choose a creature you can see within range and mystically mark it as your quarry.

Identify.description: You choose one object that you must touch throughout the casting of the spell.

Illusory Script.description: You write on parchment, paper, or some other suitable writing material and imbue it with a potent illusion that lasts for the duration.

Inflict Wounds.description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature you can reach.

Jump.description: You touch a creature. The creature's jump distance is tripled until the spell ends.

Longstrider.description: You touch a creature. The target's speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.

Magic Missile.description: You create three glowing darts of magical force.

Protection from Evil and Good.description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against certain types of creatures.

Purify Food and Drink.description: All nonmagical food and drink within a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range is purified and rendered free of poison and disease.

Ray of Sickness.description: A ray of sickening greenish energy lashes out toward a creature within range.

Sanctuary.description: You ward a creature within range against attack.

Searing Smite.description: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, your weapon flares with white-hot intensity.

Shield.description: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you.

Shield of Faith.description: A shimmering field appears and surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

Silent Image.description: You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 15-foot cube.

Sleep.description: This spell sends creatures into a magical slumber.

Snare.description: As you cast this spell, you use rope to create a circle with a 5-foot radius on the ground or the floor.

Speak with Animals.description: You gain the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts for the duration.

Tasha's Hideous Laughter.description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range perceives everything as hilariously funny and falls into fits of laughter if this spell affects it.

Tenser's Floating Disk.description: This spell creates a circular, horizontal plane of force, 3 feet in diameter and 1 inch thick, that floats 3 feet above the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range.

Thunderous Smite.description: The first time you hit with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, your weapon rings with thunder that is audible within 300 feet of you.

Thunderwave.description: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you.

Unseen Servant.description: This spell creates an invisible, mindless, shapeless force that performs simple tasks at your command until the spell ends.

Witch Bolt.description: A beam of crackling, blue energy lances out toward a creature within range.

Wrathful Smite.description: The next time you hit with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, your attack deals an extra 1d6 psychic damage.

Misty Step.description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

Counterspell.description: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell.

Fireball.description: A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame.

Lightning Bolt.description: A stroke of lightning forming a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts out from you in a direction you choose.

Haste.description: Choose a willing creature that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, the target's speed is doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to AC, it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and it gains an additional action on each of its turns.

Slow.description: You alter time around up to six creatures of your choice in a 40-foot cube within range.

Fly.description: You touch a willing creature. The target gains a flying speed of 60 feet for the duration.

Invisibility.description: A creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends.

Polymorph.description: This spell transforms a creature that you can see within range into a new form.

Teleport.description: This spell instantly transports you and up to eight willing creatures of your choice that you can see within range, or a single object that you can see within range, to a destination you select.

Wish.description: Wish is the mightiest spell a mortal creature can cast. By simply speaking aloud, you can alter the very foundations of reality in accord with your desires.

Meteor Swarm.description: Blazing orbs of fire plummet to the ground at four different points you can see within range.

Power Word Kill.description: You utter a word of power that can compel one creature you can see within range to die instantly.

Time Stop.description: You briefly stop the flow of time for everyone but yourself.

Mass Heal.description: A flood of healing energy flows from you into injured creatures around you.

True Resurrection.description: You touch a creature that has been dead for no longer than 200 years and that didn't die of old age.

Gate.description: You conjure a portal linking an unoccupied space you can see within range to a precise location on a different plane of existence.

Astral Projection.description: You and up to eight willing creatures within range project your astral bodies into the Astral Plane.

Imprisonment.description: You create a magical restraint to hold a creature.

Weird.description: Drawing on the deepest fears of a group of creatures, you create illusory creatures in their minds, visible only to them.

Prismatic Wall.description: A shimmering, multicolored plane of light forms a vertical opaque wall—up to 90 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick—centered on a point you can see within range.

Storm of Vengeance.description: A churning storm cloud forms, centered on a point you can see and spreading to a radius of 360 feet.

Foresight.description: You touch a willing creature and bestow a limited ability to see into the immediate future.

Invulnerability.description: You are immune to all damage until the spell ends.

Mass Polymorph.description: You transform up to ten creatures of your choice that you can see within range.

Power Word Heal.description: A wave of healing energy flows through you. Choose any number of creatures within 30 feet of you, and divide 700 hit points among them.

Psychic Scream.description: You unleash the power of your mind to blast the intellect of up to ten creatures of your choice that you can see within range.

Ravenous Void.description: A 20-foot-radius sphere of crushing force forms at a point you can see within range.

Shapechange.description: You assume the form of a different creature for the duration.

True Polymorph.description: Choose one creature or nonmagical object that you can see within range.

Keelboat.description: River boat with sail and oars

Balloon.description: Hot air balloon for aerial travel

Dragon Turtle Ship.description: Ship built on dragon turtle shell

Phoenix Mount.description: Magical phoenix that can be ridden

Griffon.description: Flying mount with eagle head and lion body
